summary: Osisko Gold Group filed a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting 3,933 m of underground infill drilling in 36 holes from the 1290 m level at the Lowhee Zone of its 100%-owned, permitted Cariboo Gold Project in British Columbia, including intercept highlights of 7.28 g/t Au over 16.15 m and 7.13 g/t Au over 11.60 m. Corporate items include awarding continuing underground mine development works to contractor JDS Energy Mining Inc. effective October 5, 2026, plus grants of 72,700 options and 553,700 RSUs to newly hired officers and employees under the omnibus plan. This is a routine operational and compensation update, not a special situation.
